readme:
# MINIKrea2 RTX-EZ Provisioned

Private Vast.ai template for MINIKrea2 / RTX-EZ.

This template is the provisioned version of the base template.

What it changes:
- Keeps the stable `vastai/comfy:v0.30.0-cuda-13.2-py312` base
- Adds `PROVISIONING_SCRIPT` so new instances can bootstrap consistently
- Keeps Jupyter + SSH mode and ComfyUI defaults
- Leaves model-specific setup to follow-up scripts that you can chain from the provisioning script

Important:
- Replace `PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_URL` in `env` before creating this template.
- Host the script at a raw URL that Vast can fetch directly over HTTPS.
env: -p 1111:11111 -p 8080:8080 -p 8384:8384 -p 72299:72299 -p 8188:18188 -p 8288:8288 -p 10100:10100 -p 10200:10200 -e COMFYUI_ARGS="--disable-auto-launch --disable-xformers --port 18188 --enable-cors-header" -e COMFYUI_API_BASE="http://localhost:18188" -e OPEN_BUTTON_PORT="1111" -e JUPYTER_DIR="/" -e DATA_DIRECTORY="/workspace/" -e WORKSPACE="/workspace" -e HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE="1" -e CIVITAI_BASE_URL="https://civitai.red" -e PROVISIONING_SCRIPT="PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_URL"
